concept: DynamoDB TTL: auto-deleting stale time-series records
tests: Choosing a store for IoT time-series with high write rates and automatic deletion of records older than 90 days.
expected: DynamoDB + TTL on a timestamp attribute — scalable writes, free automatic deletion of expired items. Triggers: "very high write throughput", "automatic expiration", "older than 90 days", "IoT", "keep costs low".
why_not: RDS + cron — extra load and management; S3 with manual deletion — operational overhead; Redshift — analytics, not for frequent single-row writes.
